itemList.description: Raking, cleaning and pointing on upstream face of Masonry dam joints with UV resistant, anti-shrink and high strenth materials like cements using crystaline technology (CT) polymer/Equivalent cementitious materials conforming to BIS/EN-1504-3, Class R4 (2014) standard for masonry joint filling to a depth of 5 cm including preparing of 'T' joint of masonry by removing of existing loose portion of stone masonry by breaking (using manual / mechanical means) removing existing embedded M.S. bar, racking out the masonry joints to required depth, cleaning with special chemicals and air water jet under pressure for removing algae/ fungi, applying bond coat before repair material application and top coat after finishing, complete as per specification including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, scaffolding, hire charges of cranes, insurance charges transportation with all leads and lifts and any other incidental charges as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. ---- As Directed by Engineer in charge of the work

Filling the deeper cavities or loose material area inside the masonry joints which are beyond 5cm and upto 30 cm using cementitious 1:3 (1) of OPC 53 grade cement, 3 of fine sand) cement mortar mixed with water proofing admixture (having 28th day compressive strength of more than 7.5N/mm2) inside the masonry joint upto 30 cm depth (underneath the top 5cm depth meant for pointing), using raking tools, complete as per specification including cost of all materials, machinery, Curing, labour, electricity, scaffolding, hanging platform, pullys, hire charges of cranes, all relevant safety equipments, insurance charges, transportation with all leads and lifts and any other incidental charges as directed by Project Manager. (Work will be measured and paid based on Weight of cement used in 1.3 cement sand mortar filling). ---- As Directed by Engineer in charge of the work

Pack grout filling the internal porous cavities greater than depth of 30 cm and upto 1 meter deep in the RR masonry. Treating the internal cavities greater than a depth 30cm and upto 1 metre deep in the masonry using injection pressure grouting to reduce the porosity of the masonry by drilling hole of 12.5 mm/25mm dia and 200mm deep and fixing PVC nozzles in triangular pattern. Minimum 3 nos of PVC nozzles shall be fixed per 1 sqm of the upstream area for grouting. Grouting the deep cavities inside the masonry joint using Polycementitious materials or equivalant having High strength, quick setting, zero shrink cementetious grout/ along with plasticized, expanding non shrink grout admixture under required consistency by using 40 psi grouting pump. The grouting material shall give a minimum compressive strength of 35N/mm2 in 28 days when cube tested. All works Complete using all relevant safety equipments with all lead and lifts complete as per specification including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, electricity, scaffolding, hanging platform, pullys, hire charges of cranes, curing, all relevant safety equipments, insurance charges, transportation with all leads and lifts and any other incidental charges as directed by Project Manager. (Work will be measured and paid based on weight of cement and cementitiousmixture (without water) used) ---- As Directed by Engineer in charge of the work

Cleaning concrete / masonry / rock surface for guniting / shotcreting by sand blasting method and cleaning by air and water jets after sand blasting as per specifications including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, scaffolding with all other ancillary operations complete.As directed by Engineer in charge. ---- As Directed by Engineer in charge of the work

Providing pointing to stone masonry in C M 1:2 proportion, power tool cleaning , chemical cleaning for removal of algae fungi, applying top coat after finishing complete as per specifications including cost of all materials, machinary, labour, scaffolfing, Hire charges of cranes, Insurance charges, transportation with all leads and lift as directed by Engineer incharge of work. ---- As Directed by Engineer in charge of the work
